content.class.traveller.blurb: 一根船钩、一件油布衣和一块面包头。
content.class.traveller.kit.0.name: 船钩
content.class.traveller.kit.1.name: 油布衣
content.class.traveller.name: 旅行者
content.dlg.nell.nell-root.opt.0.label: 为什么不敲钟？
content.dlg.nell.nell-root.opt.1.label: 钟在哪里？
content.dlg.nell.nell-root.opt.2.label: 我来敲钟。
content.dlg.nell.nell-root.text: 你是要坐渡船吧。船在对岸，只认钟声。我不会一个人去敲钟。这条胳膊不行。
content.dlg.nell.nell-where.opt.0.label: 为什么不敲钟？
content.dlg.nell.nell-where.opt.1.label: 我来敲钟。
content.dlg.nell.nell-where.text: 渡船屋在码头尽头。门从外面闩着。身后右边的柱子上有张告示，上面写着怎么拉门闩。
content.dlg.nell.nell-why.opt.0.label: 钟在哪里？
content.dlg.nell.nell-why.opt.1.label: 我来敲钟。
content.dlg.nell.nell-why.text: 最近三次钟响，死人都会从水湾里爬上来，爬到对面的沙嘴上。它们冲着敲钟的人来。我身边得有个能拿刀的人才行。
content.fx.ring-for-the-ferry.oc.draw-the-bolt.3: 门闩滑开了。渡船屋的门开了。
content.fx.ring-for-the-ferry.oc.read-the-notice: 渡船。敲钟一次，在码头上等候。渡船屋门从外面上闩；门旁甲板上有拉杆。天黑后不要敲钟。
content.fx.ring-for-the-ferry.oc.ring-the-bell.1: 水对面的沙嘴上，有个东西从水湾里爬了出来。接着又有一个。
content.guidance.teaching.attack-body: 等它们靠近你时，按下[[key|attack]]，持续攻击。它们动作慢，但不会停。
content.guidance.teaching.use-block: 岸边的告示牌、拉杆和钟，按[[key|use]]就会有反应。
content.guidance.teaching.use-body: 想和岸上的人说话，走近后按[[key|use]]即可。
content.npc.nell.name: 内尔·加罗
content.obj.ring-for-the-ferry.draw-the-bolt.tit: 拉下渡船屋门旁的门闩拉杆
content.obj.ring-for-the-ferry.hear-nell.title: 与渡船看守交谈
content.obj.ring-for-the-ferry.ring-the-bell.hin: 在渡船屋里，立在屋子正中的钟架上。
content.quest.ring-for-the-ferry.goal: 在码头口听内尔把话说完，读渡船告示，拉开渡船屋的门闩，敲钟，再守住岸边，挡住从沙嘴那边应声而来的东西。
content.world.boundary.message: 岸边到此为止。渡船会到码头来。
content.world.outro: 海峡对岸，一盏灯荡离了码头。渡船来了。
content.world.title: 渡船之铃

source.class.traveller.blurb: A boathook, an oilskin and a heel of bread.
source.class.traveller.kit.0.name: Boathook
source.class.traveller.kit.1.name: Oilskin
source.class.traveller.name: Traveller
source.dlg.nell.nell-root.opt.0.label: Why not ring it?
source.dlg.nell.nell-root.opt.1.label: Where is the bell?
source.dlg.nell.nell-root.opt.2.label: I'll ring it.
source.dlg.nell.nell-root.text: You'll be wanting the ferry. It lies over on the far side of the sound, and it only crosses for the bell. I won't ring that bell on my own. Not with this arm.
source.dlg.nell.nell-where.opt.0.label: Why not ring it?
source.dlg.nell.nell-where.opt.1.label: I'll ring it.
source.dlg.nell.nell-where.text: In the ferry house, at the end of the jetty. The door's bolted. Read the notice on the post there, behind you on the right. It tells you how the bolt is drawn.
source.dlg.nell.nell-why.opt.0.label: Where is the bell?
source.dlg.nell.nell-why.opt.1.label: I'll ring it.
source.dlg.nell.nell-why.text: The last three times it rang, the dead came up out of the cove onto the spit there, across the water. They make for whoever rang it. I'd want somebody beside me who can hold a blade.
source.fx.ring-for-the-ferry.oc.draw-the-bolt.3: The bolt slides back. The ferry-house door is open.
source.fx.ring-for-the-ferry.oc.read-the-notice: FERRY. Ring the bell once and wait on the jetty. The ferry-house door is bolted from outside: the lever is on the deck beside the door. Never ring after dark.
source.fx.ring-for-the-ferry.oc.ring-the-bell.1: Across the water, on the spit, something comes up out of the cove. Then another.
source.guidance.teaching.attack-body: When they reach you, press [[key|attack]] and keep at it. They are slow, and they do not stop.
source.guidance.teaching.use-block: Signs, levers and bells on this shore answer when you press [[key|use]] on them.
source.guidance.teaching.use-body: If you want a word with anyone on this shore, stand close and press [[key|use]].
source.npc.nell.name: Nell Garrow
source.obj.ring-for-the-ferry.draw-the-bolt.tit: Pull the bolt lever by the ferry-house door
source.obj.ring-for-the-ferry.hear-nell.title: Talk to the ferry-keeper
source.obj.ring-for-the-ferry.ring-the-bell.hin: Inside the ferry house, on its stand in the middle of the floor.
source.quest.ring-for-the-ferry.goal: Hear Nell out at the jetty foot, read the ferry notice, draw the ferry-house bolt, ring the bell, and hold the shore against what answers it from the spit.
source.world.boundary.message: The shore ends here. The ferry comes to the jetty.
source.world.outro: Out across the sound a lantern swings away from the far landing. The ferry is coming.
source.world.title: The Ferry Bell
